metadata.description: Language requirements for Bangladeshi CS/AI/ML students across all lifecycle stages: admission, study, work, PR, and citizenship
metadata.targetProfile: Bangladeshi student, CS/AI/ML field, age 20-32, Bengali native speaker, typically B2-C1 English proficiency
metadata.criticalNote: Language is not just admission requirement - it determines PR eligibility speed, citizenship access, salary ceiling, and social integration quality. Host country language investment from Day 1 is the single highest-ROI action a Bangladeshi student can take.

bangladeshiBaseline.englishProficiency: Generally B1-B2; university graduates typically B2; strong CS/AI candidates often C1
bangladeshiBaseline.englishTestPreference: IELTS Academic preferred over TOEFL in Australia/Canada/UK/Ireland; TOEFL preferred at US universities
bangladeshiBaseline.keyInsight: Bangladeshi students have strong English reading/writing but often weaker speaking/listening; target IELTS Speaking 7.0+ specifically

duolingo.note: Accepted at many Canadian universities as alternative

english.exemptions: Students from Bangladesh NOT exempt; test mandatory

french.note: French required for Quebec francophone universities (DELF/DALF B2); optional elsewhere

studyPhaseLanguage.mediumOfInstruction: English at all major Canadian universities
studyPhaseLanguage.hostLanguageForIntegration: English in Ontario/BC/Alberta; French in Quebec
studyPhaseLanguage.recommendedLevel: C1 English for academic success in CS/AI graduate programs
studyPhaseLanguage.frenchAdvantage: French B1+ opens Quebec immigration streams (PRTQ); significant PR advantage

workPhaseLanguage.required: English C1 for tech roles; writing and communication critical
workPhaseLanguage.frenchForQuebec: French B2 required for Quebec tech market beyond Montreal English bubble
workPhaseLanguage.salaryImpact: Bilingual (English+French) candidates earn 10-15% premium in federal roles

expressEntry.languageTest: IELTS or CELPIP; CLB 7 minimum (IELTS 6.0 each band); CLB 9+ for maximum CRS points
expressEntry.clbTarget: CLB 9 = IELTS 7.0 each band; adds 136 points to CRS score for single, 128 married

prRequirements.testValidity: IELTS/CELPIP results valid 2 years for Express Entry

citizenshipRequirements.languageTest: CLB 4 minimum (IELTS approximately 4.5 each band); lower bar than PR
citizenshipRequirements.languageInterview: Citizenship judge may assess language ability in interview
citizenshipRequirements.practicalLevel: B2 English is functionally sufficient for citizenship; higher for integration

languageRequirements.strategicRecommendation: Target IELTS 7.5 overall (7.0 each band minimum) for Express Entry maximum CRS points. Take IELTS Academic (not General) for university admission. French investment (TCF B2) opens Quebec PNP stream with significantly lower competition. CLB 9 adds substantial CRS score - retake test if needed.

ielts.note: Go8 universities often require 7.0 overall with no band below 6.5

pte.note: PTE accepted and growing in popularity; faster results

studyPhaseLanguage.integrationLanguage: English; Australian English accent exposure valuable for interview preparation
studyPhaseLanguage.recommendedLevel: C1 for research writing; PhD students should target academic writing proficiency

workPhaseLanguage.australianCommunication: Informal communication style; cultural adaptation important; networking in English critical for career

skilledIndependent189.languageTest: IELTS 6.0 each band (Competent English minimum); 7.0 each band (Proficient) = 10 extra points; 8.0 each band (Superior) = 20 extra points
skilledIndependent189.pointsImpact: Language band is single highest point contributor in Australian points test

prRequirements.testValidity: IELTS results valid 3 years for skills assessment; check specific occupation assessment body

citizenshipRequirements.languageTest: No formal test; demonstrated by PR residency and integration

languageRequirements.strategicRecommendation: IELTS Superior (8.0 each band) adds 20 points vs Competent (6.0) which adds 0 points - potentially deciding factor in PR application. PTE is faster to complete and results in 48 hours. Invest in IELTS preparation seriously; Speaking 7.0+ is where most Bangladeshi students need focused coaching.

english.note: English-medium MSc programs widely available; German not required for admission to English programs

german.englishProgramNote: German not required for English-medium programs at TU Munich, KIT, RWTH Aachen, TU Berlin
german.germanProgramRequirement: TestDaF TDN 4 or DSH-2 for German-medium programs
german.recommendedPreAdmission: B1 German before arrival; B2 by graduation

studyPhaseLanguage.researchLanguage: English sufficient for most CS/AI PhD programs
studyPhaseLanguage.dailyLife: German B1-B2 essential for daily life, banking, housing, healthcare navigation
studyPhaseLanguage.integrationReality: English-only speakers face significant social isolation; German investment critical for quality of life
studyPhaseLanguage.freeGermanCourses: Volkshochschule (VHS) offers affordable German courses; Goethe Institut online resources; DW Learn German free

workPhaseLanguage.techSector: English sufficient at international tech companies and research institutions
workPhaseLanguage.localCompanies: German B2-C1 required for most local German SME tech companies (Mittelstand)
workPhaseLanguage.salaryImpact: German C1 speakers earn 15-25% more than English-only counterparts in German market; access to far larger job pool
workPhaseLanguage.jobSearchLanguage: German B2+ dramatically expands job search beyond international companies

permanentResidenceNiederlassungserlaubni.note: B1 is legal minimum but integration test requires basic German; B2 makes life significantly easier

euBluecardPR.germanLevel: B1 required for standard PR; A1 minimum for Blue Card holders initially

citizenshipRequirements.germanLevel: B1 minimum legally; C1 strongly recommended for naturalization interview and integration
citizenshipRequirements.testRequired: Einbürgerungstest (citizenship test) in German; naturalization interview in German
citizenshipRequirements.timeline: Citizenship possible after 5 years (reduced from 8 years in 2024 reform); 3 years with special integration achievement

germanLearningRoadmap.preArrival: A1-A2: Start 12-18 months before departure; Duolingo, Goethe Institut online
germanLearningRoadmap.year1: A2-B1: VHS courses in Germany; intensive immersion

testCentersInBangladesh: British Council Dhaka (IELTS for English programs)
languageRequirements.strategicRecommendation: German B2 is THE critical investment for Germany pathway. Start German before leaving Bangladesh. English-only speakers can survive in research but cannot thrive long-term. B2 certification before PR application and C1 before citizenship. German language investment has highest ROI of any non-English language for GradPlanner users targeting Europe.

studyPhaseLanguage.integrationLanguage: English; Irish Gaeilge not required or expected from immigrants

workPhaseLanguage.required: Professional English C1; no other language needed

longTermResidence.languageTest: No formal language test required for Irish long-term residence; demonstrated through residence and employment

citizenshipRequirements.languageTest: No formal language test; Irish citizen application in English

languageRequirements.strategicRecommendation: Ireland is the easiest language destination for Bangladeshi students. English-only environment from Day 1 through citizenship. Focus IELTS preparation on Speaking 7.0+ as most Bangladeshis score lower there. No additional language investment needed.

languageRequirements.workingLanguage: English in tech/research; Dutch for broader integration

english.note: Netherlands has one of highest proportions of English-medium master programs in Europe

dutch.note: Dutch not required for admission to English-medium programs

studyPhaseLanguage.mediumOfInstruction: English at TU Delft, TU Eindhoven, UvA, Utrecht, Leiden - all major programs
studyPhaseLanguage.dutchForIntegration: Dutch B1 recommended within 2 years for daily life and social integration
studyPhaseLanguage.englisnFluency: Dutch society is extremely English-proficient (EF EPI consistently #1 globally); daily English usage very feasible

workPhaseLanguage.techSector: English sufficient at ASML, Philips, Booking.com, Adyen, TomTom, Stripe Netherlands
workPhaseLanguage.dutchCompanies: Dutch B2 needed for non-international Dutch companies
workPhaseLanguage.salaryImpact: Dutch language opens broader Dutch job market but English-only viable in international tech

permanentResidenceVergunning.dutchLevel: A2 minimum for inburgeringsexamen (civic integration exam); B1 target for full integration exam
permanentResidenceVergunning.inburgering: Civic integration requirement; language plus knowledge of Dutch society; online learning resources provided

citizenshipRequirements.dutchLevel: B1 spoken and written; naturalization interview in Dutch
citizenshipRequirements.inburgeringsdiploma: Required; includes language plus civic knowledge exam
citizenshipRequirements.timeline: 5 years residence → citizenship; language requirement central

dutchLearningRoadmap.year1: A1-A2: Duolingo Dutch, Babbel, free NT2 courses
dutchLearningRoadmap.year2: A2-B1: Inburgeringscursus (integration course); state subsidized for many residents

languageRequirements.strategicRecommendation: Dutch A2-B1 required for PR and citizenship but English is sufficient for daily life and tech work. The 30% ruling (tax benefit) does not require Dutch language. Invest in Dutch from Year 1 through free Taalhuis library courses and NT2 online resources. B1 by Year 3 is achievable with consistent effort.

languageRequirements.workingLanguage: English in tech/research; Swedish for full integration

english.note: KTH, Chalmers, Uppsala, Linköping all offer English-medium CS/AI programs

swedish.note: Swedish not required for English-medium programs

studyPhaseLanguage.mediumOfInstruction: English at all major Swedish universities for CS/AI programs
studyPhaseLanguage.swedishForIntegration: Swedish B1 within 2-3 years strongly recommended; SFI (Svenska för invandrare) free state-provided Swedish courses
studyPhaseLanguage.sfi: SFI (Swedish for Immigrants) is FREE mandatory language program for all residents; excellent quality; highly recommended

workPhaseLanguage.techSector: English sufficient at Spotify, Ericsson, King, Klarna, Mojang, iZettle
workPhaseLanguage.swedishCompanies: Swedish B2 needed for Swedish public sector and domestic companies
workPhaseLanguage.salaryImpact: Swedish B2+ opens broader Swedish job market; approximately 15-20% more opportunities

permanentResidence.swedishLevel: No formal language test required legally; BUT Swedish proficiency demonstrated through integration activities is evaluated
permanentResidence.practicalNote: Swedish B1+ practically expected by migration officers; SFI completion certificate is positive evidence

citizenshipRequirements.languageTest: No formal language test for Swedish citizenship (unique among Scandinavian countries)
citizenshipRequirements.practicalLevel: Swedish B1 functional; Swedish social integration demonstrated through residence period
citizenshipRequirements.note: Sweden notably does NOT require language test for citizenship - significant advantage over Denmark/Norway/Finland

sfiDetails.description: SFI is free Swedish language education for adult immigrants; 4 tracks (A/B/C/D) based on education level; Track D for university graduates
sfiDetails.duration: Typically 1-2 years part-time; flexible scheduling around university
sfiDetails.outcome: Track D completion equivalent to approximately B1-B2 Swedish
sfiDetails.registration: Register at local municipality adult education (vuxenutbildning) office

languageRequirements.strategicRecommendation: Swedish is genuinely optional for tech career but essential for social integration and citizenship security. Use FREE SFI from Month 1. No citizenship language test is Sweden's biggest immigration advantage vs Denmark/Norway. Swedish B1 by Year 2 is very achievable with SFI. WASP program PhD positions are English-only environments.

languageRequirements.workingLanguage: English in tech/research; Finnish for broader integration

english.note: Aalto, Helsinki, Tampere all offer English-medium CS/AI programs

finnish.note: Finnish not required for English-medium programs; very difficult language (Finno-Ugric family)

studyPhaseLanguage.mediumOfInstruction: English at Aalto, University of Helsinki, Tampere University CS programs
studyPhaseLanguage.finnishReality: Finnish is one of world's most difficult languages for English speakers; not expected quickly
studyPhaseLanguage.freeLanguageCourses: Universities offer free Finnish language courses; Finnish language studies certificate valued for PR

workPhaseLanguage.techSector: English sufficient at Aalto startup ecosystem, Nokia, Rovio, Supercell, Wärtsilä
workPhaseLanguage.publicSector: Finnish B2 required for any public sector role
workPhaseLanguage.salaryImpact: Finnish language opens public sector and Finnish SME market but international tech in English

permanentResidence.finnishLevel: B1 Finnish (or B1 Swedish); OR A2 with other integration evidence
permanentResidence.languageTestOptions: YKI (National Certificate of Language Proficiency); level 3 = B1

citizenshipRequirements.finnishLevel: B1 Finnish or Swedish; YKI Level 3 test required OR evidence of language use
citizenshipRequirements.timeline: 5 years residence; language requirement central to citizenship application

finnishLearningReality.difficulty: VERY HIGH - Finnish is agglutinative language with 15 grammatical cases; no Latin/Germanic roots
finnishLearningReality.realisticTimeline: A1: 6 months intensive; A2: 1 year; B1: 2-3 years consistent study
finnishLearningReality.alternativeSwedish: B1 Swedish (instead of Finnish) also accepted; Swedish easier for English speakers

languageRequirements.strategicRecommendation: Finnish language investment is the biggest challenge in Finland pathway. B1 Finnish required for PR and citizenship but takes 2-3 years minimum. Start free university Finnish courses from Day 1. Consider Swedish as alternative (B1 Swedish accepted). Finland's aging population demographic creates genuine long-term immigration need making this investment worthwhile.

languageRequirements.workingLanguage: English in tech/research; Danish increasingly required for settlement

english.note: DTU, Aarhus, Copenhagen, ITU all English-medium CS/AI programs

studyPhaseLanguage.danishForIntegration: Danish B2 becoming increasingly required for long-term settlement
studyPhaseLanguage.studieStartProgram: Danish language courses (danskuddannelse) free for residents through municipality

workPhaseLanguage.techSector: English sufficient at major Danish tech companies and Copenhagen startup scene
workPhaseLanguage.danishPolicy: Danish government increasingly expects Danish language for integration; job market broader with Danish

permanentResidence.additionalRequirements: Employment, self-sufficiency, passed civic test, no criminal record; language is one of multiple requirements

citizenshipRequirements.danishLevel: Prøve i Dansk 3 (PD3) = B2 level; strict requirement; one of Europe's hardest citizenship language requirements
citizenshipRequirements.timeline: 9 years residence currently; language is gating factor
citizenshipRequirements.note: Denmark has tightened citizenship requirements significantly 2021-2025; PD3 B2 is genuine challenge

danishLearningRoadmap.year1: A1-A2: Danskuddannelse 3 (for educated immigrants); free municipality courses
danishLearningRoadmap.year2: A2-B1: Continue danskuddannelse; pass Prøve i Dansk 2
danishLearningRoadmap.year3to4: B1-B2: Prøve i Dansk 3 preparation; most demanding stage

languageRequirements.strategicRecommendation: Danish B2 (PD3) for citizenship is one of Europe's hardest language requirements. Start danskuddannelse from Month 1 - it is FREE and specifically designed for immigrants. Researcher Tax Scheme (27% flat tax) makes Denmark financially excellent despite language investment required. Target Prøve i Dansk 2 (B1) by Year 3, PD3 (B2) by Year 6.

languageRequirements.workingLanguage: English in tech/research; Norwegian for full integration

english.note: NTNU, Oslo, Bergen all English-medium CS programs available

studyPhaseLanguage.mediumOfInstruction: English for most NTNU CS/AI programs
studyPhaseLanguage.norwegianIntegration: Norwegian B1 strongly recommended; free courses available through municipality
studyPhaseLanguage.freeCourses: Norskopplæring (Norwegian classes) free for immigrants through municipality

workPhaseLanguage.techSector: English sufficient at Equinor, Kongsberg, Telenor, Opera
workPhaseLanguage.norwegianBenefit: Norwegian B2 significantly expands job market; most Norwegian companies prefer Norwegian speakers

permanentResidence.additionalNote: 750 hours norskopplæring (Norwegian instruction) obligation for some permit holders; register immediately on arrival

citizenshipRequirements.norwegianLevel: B1 oral and written; Norskprøve (Norwegian test) Level B1 required
citizenshipRequirements.timeline: 7 years residence; language is central requirement

norwegianLearningRoadmap.advantage: Norwegian is MUCH easier than Finnish/Danish for English speakers; Germanic language with many English cognates
norwegianLearningRoadmap.timeline: A1: 3 months; B1: 12-18 months realistic for motivated learner

languageRequirements.strategicRecommendation: Norwegian is among the easiest Scandinavian languages for English speakers. B1 achievable in 12-18 months. Free municipality language courses (norskopplæring) - register immediately on arrival. Norway's excellent stability and 3-year PR pathway makes language investment highly worthwhile.

languageRequirements.workingLanguage: English in research; German/French depending on canton

ielts.note: ETH Zurich and EPFL are highly competitive; strong academic record more important than language score

german.note: ETH Zurich: German not required for English PhD programs

french.note: EPFL Lausanne: French not required for English PhD programs; most doctoral programs in English

studyPhaseLanguage.ethZurich: German-speaking canton (Zurich); research in English; daily life in German; German A2+ strongly recommended
studyPhaseLanguage.epflLausanne: French-speaking canton (Vaud); research in English; daily life in French; French A2+ recommended
studyPhaseLanguage.cantonalLanguage: Learning cantonal language is high-ROI for quality of life despite research being English

workPhaseLanguage.researchAcademic: English exclusively sufficient at ETH/EPFL and Google/Microsoft Zurich
workPhaseLanguage.industrySwiss: German C1 for Swiss German companies; French B2 for Romandy companies
workPhaseLanguage.salaryImpact: German/French fluency opens Swiss Mittelstand and banking sector with very high salaries

cPermit.germanOrFrenchLevel: B1 minimum; B2 strongly recommended for canton where residing
cPermit.integrationCriteria: Language is key integration criterion alongside employment and self-sufficiency

citizenshipRequirements.cantonalLanguage: B1 minimum; many cantons require C1 or language interview at B2 level
citizenshipRequirements.civicKnowledge: Test on Swiss history, political system, cantonal knowledge
citizenshipRequirements.timeline: 10 years residence (reduced to 5 for some cantons with integration achievement)
citizenshipRequirements.difficulty: One of Europe's most complex citizenship processes; cantonal variation adds complexity

languageRequirements.strategicRecommendation: Language investment depends on target canton. ETH Zurich PhD: invest in German A2-B1 for daily quality of life while research is in English. EPFL Lausanne: invest in French A2-B1. Swiss citizenship is complex and long-term; focus on German/French B2 by Year 4-5. Many use Switzerland as career launchpad (ETH PhD) then transition to Germany/Netherlands for simpler PR pathway.

toefl.note: TOEFL preferred over IELTS at most US universities; MIT/Stanford recommend 100+; CMU 100+

ielts.note: IELTS accepted but TOEFL more standard at US universities

gre.note: Many top CS programs dropped GRE requirement 2020-2024; check specific program; some reinstating 2025-2026

english.speakingNote: TOEFL Speaking 24+ critically important; US universities assess speaking for TA roles

studyPhaseLanguage.taRequirement: Teaching Assistant (TA) positions often require English Speaking TOEFL 24+ or SPEAK test; critical for funding
studyPhaseLanguage.academicEnglish: Technical academic English for CS/AI research papers at C1-C2 level expected from Year 1

workPhaseLanguage.communicationStyle: American professional communication style is direct and presentation-focused; soft skills in English crucial for career advancement
workPhaseLanguage.h1bNote: No language requirement for H-1B; English proficiency demonstrated through degree and employment

greenCard.languageTest: No formal English language test for employment-based Green Card (EB-1/EB-2/EB-3)
greenCard.civicsTest: N/A for PR; relevant for citizenship

citizenshipRequirements.englishLevel: B2 English reading, writing, speaking required for naturalization; USCIS English test administered during interview
citizenshipRequirements.civicsTest: 100 civics questions (English); must answer 6 of 10 correctly

testStrategy.speakingFocus: TOEFL Speaking 24+ essential for TA funding eligibility; most Bangladeshi students weak here; invest 3-4 months specifically
testStrategy.writingFocus: TOEFL Writing 24+ for strong application; practice academic essay writing

languageRequirements.strategicRecommendation: TOEFL 110+ dramatically strengthens US PhD applications and TA eligibility. Invest specifically in TOEFL Speaking (24+) - most Bangladeshi students score 20-22 without preparation. American communication style (presentations, networking, office conversation) is different from Bangladeshi academic English; practice with US YouTube content, podcasts, and mock interviews.

english.note: Many English-medium CS/AI programs exist at UTokyo, Tokyo Tech, Kyoto, Osaka; English-medium MEXT pathway available

japanese.englishProgramNote: Japanese not required for English-medium programs
japanese.mextRequirement: MEXT scholarship: Japanese language course provided during research student phase; JLPT not required at admission
japanese.japaneseAdvantage: JLPT N2+ dramatically expands career opportunities and salary ceiling

studyPhaseLanguage.researchLanguage: English sufficient for research at major Japanese universities
studyPhaseLanguage.dailyLifeReality: Japanese N3-N2 essential for daily life; banking, housing, hospital navigation requires Japanese
studyPhaseLanguage.japaneseUniversityLife: Japanese lab culture requires some Japanese for social integration; labmates mostly Japanese speakers
studyPhaseLanguage.freeCourses: JASSO and municipalities provide free/subsidized Japanese language courses; JICA also provides resources

workPhaseLanguage.internationalCompanies: Google Japan, Amazon Japan, Microsoft Japan, Apple Japan: English sufficient; pay USD 80,000-130,000+ annually
workPhaseLanguage.japaneseCompanies: Japanese N1-N2 required for Sony, Toyota, NTT, Fujitsu, NEC, Hitachi; massive salary increase with Japanese fluency
workPhaseLanguage.salaryImpact: JLPT N1 in AI/CS: 30-50% salary premium vs English-only; access to entire Japanese tech market
workPhaseLanguage.startupScene: Tokyo tech startups increasingly bilingual; English-friendly emerging

hspPointsSystem.japaneseBonus: JLPT N1 = +15 HSP points; JLPT N2 = +10 HSP points; significant PR speed acceleration
hspPointsSystem.prTimeline: HSP 80+ points = PR in 1 year (vs standard 10 years); language is single biggest points contributor

citizenshipRequirements.japaneseLevel: N2 practical minimum; N1 recommended; citizenship interview entirely in Japanese
citizenshipRequirements.civilServant: Ministry of Justice examines Japanese ability in naturalization interview
citizenshipRequirements.timeline: 5 years residence; language ability is critical evaluation criterion

jlptRoadmap.preArrival: N5: 6 months study; basic hiragana/katakana/vocabulary before departure
jlptRoadmap.year1: N4: Achieve by end of Year 1; essential for daily life
jlptRoadmap.year3: N2: Career-relevant; HSP points bonus; PR acceleration
jlptRoadmap.year4to5: N1: Full professional Japanese; maximum career and citizenship benefit
resources: NHK Web Easy (news in simple Japanese)
jlptRoadmap.testSchedule: JLPT held twice/year: July and December globally including Bangladesh

testCentersInBangladesh: British Council Dhaka (IELTS/TOEFL for English requirements)
languageRequirements.strategicRecommendation: Japanese language investment is THE most important strategic decision for Japan pathway. JLPT N2 adds 10 HSP points potentially cutting PR timeline from 10 years to 1-3 years. N1 opens entire Japanese corporate AI market with 30-50% salary premium. Start Japanese from Day 1 of deciding Japan pathway. N5 pre-arrival, N4 Year 1, N3 Year 2, N2 Year 3 is realistic timeline with consistent daily study.

english.note: KAIST, POSTECH, SNU all offer English-medium graduate programs in CS/AI

korean.kgspNote: KGSP scholarship includes free 1-year Korean language training before degree program; no prior Korean needed
korean.advantage: TOPIK 4+ opens Korean tech market far beyond international companies

studyPhaseLanguage.researchLanguage: English sufficient at KAIST, POSTECH for research and academic activities
studyPhaseLanguage.kgspLanguageYear: KGSP provides 1 full year of Korean language training (paid); reach TOPIK 3-4 level by end
studyPhaseLanguage.labLife: Korean lab environment; Korean colleagues; TOPIK 3+ for social integration; professors often bilingual

workPhaseLanguage.internationalCompanies: Samsung Global, Kakao international teams, Naver Global AI Lab: English-friendly
workPhaseLanguage.koreanCompanies: TOPIK 5-6 for Samsung Korea mainstream, Hyundai, LG domestic, SK Hynix; massive career expansion
workPhaseLanguage.salaryImpact: TOPIK 5+ in AI/CS: access to entire Korean chaebol ecosystem; significant salary and stability premium
workPhaseLanguage.startupScene: Seoul tech startup scene increasingly English-friendly

f2Visa.koreanLevel: TOPIK 2 minimum; TOPIK 4+ strongly preferred; points-based KIIP completion helps

prRequirements.kiip: Korea Immigration and Integration Program (KIIP): social integration program with 5 levels; completion adds PR points; Korean language integral

hspF2.koreanBonus: TOPIK 5-6 = highest language points in HSP system; significantly accelerates F-2 → F-5 transition

citizenshipRequirements.koreanLevel: TOPIK 4 minimum for naturalization; interview in Korean
citizenshipRequirements.kiip: KIIP Level 5 completion strongly linked to citizenship approval
citizenshipRequirements.timeline: 5 years → F-5 PR; additional 2+ years → citizenship possible

topikRoadmap.kgspYear: TOPIK 1-2: During free KGSP language year
topikRoadmap.year3to4: TOPIK 5-6: Full professional Korean; maximum PR and career benefit
resources: Talk To Me In Korean (TTMIK - excellent free resource)
topikRoadmap.testSchedule: TOPIK held 6 times/year globally; registration through NIIED

topikLevels.topik2: Levels 3-4: Intermediate; functional daily use; PR minimum
topikLevels.topik2Advanced: Levels 5-6: Advanced professional; citizenship and career premium

languageRequirements.strategicRecommendation: KGSP's free 1-year Korean language training is unique globally - no other scholarship provides this. Use the KGSP year intensively to reach TOPIK 3-4. Continue to TOPIK 5+ during degree. Korean TOPIK 5+ is career-transformative in Korea's tech market. KIIP program (free social integration) accelerates PR pathway. Korea-Bangladesh tax treaty prevents double taxation.

languageRequirements.workingLanguage: Chinese Mandarin (primary); English in research/international companies

english.note: Tsinghua, Peking University, SJTU offer English-medium CS/AI programs specifically designed for international students

hsk.required: HSK 4 for Chinese-medium programs; not required for English-medium programs

chinese.cscNote: CSC scholarship: Chinese language courses typically provided during first semester; no prior Chinese needed for English-medium programs

studyPhaseLanguage.englishMediumPrograms: Research and coursework in English at international programs; feasible without Chinese
studyPhaseLanguage.dailyLifeReality: Mandarin essential for daily life; apps, food delivery, banking, transportation all primarily Chinese-language
studyPhaseLanguage.vpnNote: WeChat Pay, Alipay required for daily transactions; setup requires Chinese guidance; language barrier real
studyPhaseLanguage.hskCourses: Universities provide free Mandarin courses for international students; HSK 4 target by Year 2

workPhaseLanguage.internationalTeams: Alibaba International, Bytedance global teams, Tencent international: English-friendly; high salaries
workPhaseLanguage.chineseTech: Huawei mainstream, Baidu core, DJI: Mandarin HSK 5-6 required; massive career expansion
workPhaseLanguage.salaryImpact: HSK 5+ in AI/CS: 40-60% more job opportunities; access to full Chinese tech market
workPhaseLanguage.startupScene: Shenzhen and Shanghai startup scenes increasingly require Chinese

foreignerPermanentResidence.chineseLevel: HSK 5 minimum practically expected; formal requirement not publicly standardized
foreignerPermanentResidence.difficulty: China PR (绿卡) is extremely rare and difficult; approximately 10,000 foreigners hold it nationally
foreignerPermanentResidence.alternativePath: Long-term residence permit more achievable than formal PR

citizenshipRequirements.reality: Chinese citizenship essentially unavailable for non-ethnic Chinese; voluntary renunciation of foreign citizenship required; not a realistic pathway
citizenshipRequirements.note: Plan China as a 3-5 year career phase, not permanent settlement

hskRoadmap.preArrival: Pinyin and basic tones: 2-3 months pre-departure; Duolingo Chinese, ChinesePod
hskRoadmap.year1: HSK 3: University Chinese courses; functional daily communication
hskRoadmap.year2: HSK 4: Admission requirement for Chinese programs; functional professional
hskRoadmap.year4: HSK 6: Advanced professional; maximum career benefit
hskRoadmap.characterLearning: Simplified characters for mainland China; learn writing via Pleco stroke order; 2,500 characters for HSK 5

languageRequirements.strategicRecommendation: Mandarin HSK 4-5 is career-transformative in China but not required for initial admission to English programs. Daily life in China without Mandarin is genuinely difficult due to app/payment ecosystem being Chinese-only. CSC scholarship Chinese language courses are the foundation - attend diligently from Day 1. Target HSK 4 by Year 2, HSK 5 by graduation. This language skill has value beyond China - carries career weight in Singapore, Taiwan, and global Chinese tech companies. Plan China as 3-5 year career phase with language as a permanent portable asset.

ieltsAcademic.bangladeshiAdvantage: Most familiar format; widely coached in Dhaka

toeflIbt.bangladeshiAdvantage: Preferred at US universities; computer-based format

pte.bangladeshiAdvantage: Fastest results; AI-graded (consistent scoring); growing acceptance

duolingo.bangladeshiAdvantage: Cheapest; at-home test; growing acceptance but not universally accepted

hostLanguageTests.japaneseJLPT: N5-N1; HSP points bonus; held twice/year globally including Bangladesh; Japan Foundation Dhaka
hostLanguageTests.koreanTOPIK: Levels 1-6; KIIP and visa points; held 6 times/year; Korean Cultural Center Dhaka
hostLanguageTests.chineseHSK: Levels 1-6; Hanban/Confucius Institute; available at multiple Dhaka centers
hostLanguageTests.dutchNT2: Taken in Netherlands; not available in Bangladesh pre-departure
hostLanguageTests.swedishSFI: Taken in Sweden through municipality; not available in Bangladesh
hostLanguageTests.danishPrøve: Taken in Denmark; not available in Bangladesh pre-departure
hostLanguageTests.norwegianNorskprøve: Taken in Norway; not available in Bangladesh pre-departure
hostLanguageTests.finnishYKI: Taken in Finland; not available in Bangladesh pre-departure

priorityLanguageInvestmentGuide.englishFirst: ALL pathways require IELTS 7.0+ or TOEFL 100+. This is non-negotiable. Invest BDT 15,000-25,000 in preparation courses before test.
